runs.text: PART 1 — THE PERSON YOU LEARNED TO BECOME
Shayad insaan ki sabse badi kahani woh nahi hoti jo woh duniya ko sunata hai.
Sabse badi kahani woh hoti hai…
jo woh roz bina awaaz ke khud ko sunata rehta hai.
Ye teen shabd bahut chhote hain.
Lekin kai zindagiyan inhi teen shabdon ke andar simat jaati hain.
Hum aksar sochte hain ki hum apni identity discover karte hain.
hum apni identity inherit karte hain.
jinhone kabhi humein define kar diya tha.
THE FIRST NAME WE NEVER CHOSE
Jab ek bachcha paida hota hai…
usse apne baare mein kuch nahi pata hota.
Usse nahi pata ki woh intelligent hai ya average.
Ye sab baad mein aata hai.
bachcha un baaton ko sunna shuru karta hai.
Shuru mein ye sirf observations hote hain.
Insaan ko yaad bhi nahi rehta…
ki usne ye identity kab accept ki.
WHEN A MOMENT BECOMES A DEFINITION
Life mein hazaar moments hote hain.
Par mind unmein se kuch ko choose karta hai.
Ek stage pe words bhool gaye.
Ek baar kisi ne compare kar diya.
Lekin mind ne unhe permanent bana diya.
Par us moment se nikla hua sentence…
usi sentence ke against judge hone laga.
THE MASK THAT STARTS FEELING REAL
Identity kabhi ek din mein nahi banti.
Jitni baar tum ek hi sentence khud ko bolte ho…
utni baar woh sentence sach jaisa feel hone lagta hai.
Baad mein introductions ban jaate hain.
jo uski identity allow karti hai.
Aur jo uski identity allow nahi karti…
uske baare mein woh pehle hi decide kar leta hai—
Sabse silent tragedy ye nahi hoti…
ki duniya tumhe galat samajh leti hai.
Sabse silent tragedy ye hoti hai…
ki tum khud se milna band kar dete ho.
purane naam ke through dekhi jaati hai.
Jaise life continuously badal rahi ho…
par observer wahi purana khada ho.
Aur phir ek waqt aata hai…
Woh sirf apni purani definition ko aur polish karta rehta hai.
"Jo main apne baare mein maanta hoon… woh aaya kahan se?"
Ya kisi difficult phase ka conclusion?
Kya woh present ka truth hai?
jo abhi tak andar ghoom rahi hai?
Shayad identity ki sabse badi problem ye nahi…
ki woh itni familiar ho jaati hai…
ki hum usse kabhi question hi nahi karte.
Aur shayad asli prison deewaron se nahi banti.
Woh un sentences se banti hai…
jo humne kabhi bina verify kiye accept kar liye.
sabse purana jhoot woh hota hai…
jo hum apne baare mein sach samajh kar jee rahe hote hain.
PART 2 — WHY BEING UNDERSTOOD FEELS LIKE SURVIVAL
Sabse pehle... wo chahta hai ki koi usse waise dekhe jaise wo khud ko feel karta hai.
Kyuki jab andar ki reality aur bahar ki understanding match karti hai...
Jab koi tumhari baat galat samajhta hai...
toh frustration sirf misunderstanding ka nahi hota.
Pain is baat ka hota hai ki...
tumhari reality kisi aur tak pahunch hi nahi paayi.
Aur us moment pe insaan sirf explain nahi karta...
wo almost apni existence defend kar raha hota hai.
Kyuki har explanation ke peeche ek silent sentence hota hai—
"Please mujhe waise dekho jaisa main hoon."
Kuch log ek baar explain karte hain.
Kuch log saalon tak karte rehte hain.
yeh validation ki craving nahi hoti.
Yeh ek silent hope hoti hai—
"Shayad is baar koi sach mein samajh le."
Har extra explanation ke peeche information kam hoti hai...
aur acceptance ki need zyada hoti hai.
THE WEIGHT OF AN INCORRECT IMAGE
Sabke dimaag mein humari ek image banti hai.
Aur problem image banne mein nahi hai.
jab woh image humse bilkul alag hoti hai.
log tumhe arrogant bol dete hain.
log tumhe attitude samajh lete hain.
log tumhe careless keh dete hain.
tum sirf unke words se hurt nahi hote.
Tum is baat se hurt hote ho...
ki jis insaan ko wo judge kar rahe hain...
WHEN WE START PERFORMING TO BE UNDERSTOOD
insaan natural rehna chhod deta hai.
Wo perform karna start karta hai.
taaki log usse galat na samajhein.
utna original self aur invisible hota jata hai.
log performance ko hi personality maan lete hain.
Loneliness hamesha akela hone ka naam nahi hai.
sabke beech baith kar bhi insaan lonely feel karta hai.
Kyuki connection presence se nahi banta.
Agar koi tumhare saamne baitha hai...
par tumhe dekh nahi pa raha...
ek din hum chup ho jaate hain.
Kabhi kabhi insaan isliye silent nahi hota...
kyuki uske paas words nahi hote.
kyuki usne hope lose kar di hoti hai ki koi samajh bhi payega.
Aur jab hope khatam ho jaye...
toh explanation bhi khatam ho jati hai.
zindagi mein kuch conversations humein hamesha yaad rehti hain.
Na isliye kyuki unmein perfect advice mili thi.
Na isliye kyuki kisi ne problem solve kar di thi.
yeh feeling saari healing se bhi zyada powerful hoti hai.
Sabse dangerous prison wo nahi hota jisme walls hoti hain.
Sabse dangerous prison wo hota hai...
jisme insaan ko kabhi pata hi nahi chalta ki wo andar band hai.
Aur psychological prisons exactly waise hi kaam karti hain.
wo tumhari reality ban jaati hai.
WHEN A THOUGHT STOPS BEING A THOUGHT
Par kuch thoughts ruk jaate hain.
Kyuki hum unse argue nahi karte...
hum unpe believe kar lete hain.
Aur jis moment ek thought belief ban gaya...
us moment usne tumhari perception pe ownership le li.
Ab tum thought ko nahi dekhte.
Tum thought ke through duniya dekhte ho.
par poori life wahi change kar deta hai.
Insaan uncertainty se itna uncomfortable hota hai...
ki kabhi kabhi galat certainty choose kar leta hai.
"I know wo mujhe ignore kar raha hai."
"I know log kabhi change nahi hote."
Har sentence "I know" se start hota hai.
Mind certainty ko truth samajhta hai.
WHY THE MIND LOVES FAMILIAR PAIN
Kyuki familiar pain predictable hota hai.
Isliye kai log unknowingly wahi relationships choose karte hain...
jahan unhe pehle bhi hurt mila tha.
Par emotional script same rehti hai.
Aur known hamesha safe feel hota hai.
Chahe wo destroy hi kyu na kar raha ho.
THE IDENTITY THAT BUILDS ITS OWN WALLS
Ek belief baar baar repeat hota hai.
Phir wo personality lagne lagta hai.
Aur labels dheere dheere instructions ban gaye.
purane label ke hisaab se process hone laga.
Kyuki identity ko survive karna tha.
Psychological prison ki sabse dangerous quality ye hai...
wo khud ko protect karta hai.
Mind turant defensive ho jata hai.
ki tum uske existence pe doubt karo.
Isliye wo har opposite evidence ko reject karta hai.
Aur har supporting evidence ko collect karta rehta hai.
Us tak reality pahunch hi nahi paati.
THE COST OF NEVER QUESTIONING YOURSELF
Kabhi kabhi hum dusron ko question karte karte...
khud ko question karna bhool jaate hain.
Kyuki isme ego ko risk hota hai.
koi bhi insaan mentally free nahi ho sakta.
WHEN THE PRISON FEELS LIKE HOME
Sabse shocking moment tab aata hai...
jab prison home lagne lagta hai.
Tum usi tareeke se sochte ho.
Usi tareeke se react karte ho.
Usi tareeke se logon ko dekhte ho.
Aur ek din tum bhool jaate ho...
ki kabhi tum isse alag bhi the.
Aur invisible cheezein hi sabse zyada control karti hain.
THE FIRST CRACK IN THE WALL
Har prison ek hi jagah se tootna shuru hota hai.
Ye weakness ka question nahi hai.
Kyuki jis insaan ke paas apni certainty ko challenge karne ki capacity hoti hai...
usi ke paas reality ke paas jaane ka chance hota hai.
Shayad har belief sach na ho.
Shayad har fear future na ho.
Shayad har interpretation reality na ho.
azadi ka pehla darwaza chhupa hota hai.
THE EXIT DOESN’T FEEL LIKE EXIT
Sabse ajeeb baat ye hoti hai…
ki psychological prison se nikalna koi dramatic moment nahi hota.
Bas ek soft shift hota hai…
jahan tum pehli baar apni hi soch ko “final” nahi maante.
WHEN THE SYSTEM STARTS LOSING ITS AUTHORITY
aur uske baad turant belief ban jata tha.
par uska weight kam ho jata hai.
Ye sentence hi system ko weaken kar deta hai.
Kyuki prison ka power bars se nahi aata…
Aur jahan authority doubt ho jati hai…
THE GAP BETWEEN THOUGHT AND REACTION
Ek naya space create hota hai.
Aur ye pause hi freedom hai.
par tumhare andar ka automatic response toot jata hai.
Prison ka core structure ek cheez pe based tha:
“Main jo samajh raha hoon, wahi sach hai.”
Aur exit tab start hota hai…
jab ye line crack ho jati hai.
Kyuki jahan certainty toot ti hai…
wahan curiosity wapas aa jati hai.
Pehele har insaan proof hota tha:
Aur actions sirf actions ban jaate hain.
Ek message bas message hota hai.
Ek silence bas space hota hai.
Ek delay bas timing hoti hai.
ki complexity duniya mein nahi thi.
Complexity tumhare interpretation system mein thi.
FINAL LAYER: YOU WERE NEVER LOCKED, ONLY FILTERING
Sabse deep realization ye hota hai:
tum kabhi physically ya externally trap nahi the.
Tum bas ek filter ke through dekh rahe the.
Aur filter itna normal lagne laga tha…
ki tumhe laga wahi world hai.
Par jaise hi filter weak hota hai…
